 News › News News › Important days in November 2026: Full list of National and International days, events and festivals Important days in November 2026: Full list of National and International days, events and festivals
 Jasleen Taneja Updated: Oct 28, 2026, 23:47 IST Important days in November 2026 November 2026 carries a calendar of national rule changes, Diwali break, holidays, UN and UNESCO international days, and festivals. The UN is also marking 2026 as the International Year of Volunteers for Sustainable Development.
 Scroll below to know about all the important days in November 2026.
 Important days in November 2026 in India 
 With the festival of lights celebrated on November 8, the country is already lit with lights and rangolis and flower decoration. Then there are Guru Nanak Dev ji’s birthday, Chhath puja, Bhai dooj and other festivals too. However, the Indian government also plans to launch some rule changes effective from November 1, 2026. Let’s know about these important days below.
 November rule changes
 Several financial and administrative changes take effect or fall due this month. A recent report on November’s financial changes lists the following:
 Revised GST framework: The Central Board of Indirect Taxes and Customs (CBIC) issued a notification on October 26, and the first phase of the GST reforms takes effect on November 1, 2026. The updated framework covers post-sale discounts, faster refund processing and compliance relief for exporters.
 LPG price review: Oil marketing companies review LPG prices on the first of each month and may revise rates on November 1. Most LPG rules are carried forward from October, and the biggest possible change is a revision in commercial or domestic prices. Aadhaar-based authentication for subsidised refills is an existing requirement, not a new one.
 Fixed deposit rates: Banks are expected to revise FD interest rates on select tenures after the Reserve Bank of India raised the repo rate at its latest policy meeting.
 Digital payments in Tamil Nadu: From November 1, TASMAC liquor outlets will require digital payment (UPI, debit or credit card) for purchases above ₹1,000. This is a state-level rule.
 Deadlines to note 
 Life certificate for pensioners: Pensioners must submit their annual life certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) by the end of November. Super senior pensioners aged 80 and above began on October 1, and all others can complete verification between November 1 and November 30, 2026.
 ITR deadline for audited assessees: The filing deadline for assessees who need an audit is November 21, after an extension.
 National Campaign on Entrepreneurship-II: The campaign under DAY-NRLM runs until November 21, 2026..
 November 2026 holiday list (central government) 
 Diwali falls on Sunday, November 8, and Guru Nanak Jayanti on Tuesday, November 24. Both are gazetted holidays, and Guru Nanak Jayanti is observed nationally except in a few states. Restricted holidays are Govardhan Puja (Monday, November 9), Bhai Dooj (Wednesday, November 11) and Chhath Puja (Sunday, November 15). 
 Check out November holiday list below.
 Date Occasion Type 
 Nov 6 Dhanteras Festival 
 Nov 7 Choti Diwali (Naraka Chaturdashi) Festival 
 Nov 8 Diwali (Lakshmi Puja) Gazetted 
 Nov 9 Govardhan Puja Restricted 
 Nov 11 Bhai Dooj Restricted 
 Nov 15 Chhath Puja Restricted 
 Nov 24 Guru Nanak Jayanti / Kartik Purnima Gazetted 
 Dates for Dhanteras and Choti Diwali are from a festival calendar. Some lists put Bhai Dooj on November 10, so check your office or school circular.
 Bank holidays in November 2026 
 Banks follow RBI’s calendar plus state notifications. Listed closures include Diwali (November 8), Deepavali holiday (November 9), Bhai Dooj (November 11), the second Saturday (November 14), Chhath Puja (November 15), Guru Nanak Jayanti (November 24) and the fourth Saturday (November 28). 
 Sundays fall on November 1, 8, 15, 22 and 29. Not every holiday applies in every state.

 Sources: Haryana Day, Puducherry Liberation Day and Kut on November 1; Maharashtra’s Diwali (Bali Pratipada) holiday on November 10; West Bengal’s extra Chhath Puja day on November 16; Wangala, Karthika Purnima and Kanakadasa Jayanti.
 Long weekends: Diwali on a Sunday means no extra day off in many offices, though Govardhan Puja on Monday, November 9 may give a long weekend where observed. 
 Guru Nanak Jayanti on Tuesday, November 24 can make a four-day break for those taking Monday off.

 Festival holidays in November 2026 
 Diwali (November 8): The five-day festival of lights runs from Dhanteras to Bhai Dooj, with Lakshmi Puja as the main day.
 Chhath Puja (November 15): Devotees offer prayers to the Sun god at rivers and ponds at dawn and dusk.
 Guru Nanak Jayanti (November 24): It marks the birth anniversary of Guru Nanak Dev ji, the founder of Sikhism, and coincides with Kartik Purnima in 2026.
 Tips for planning the month 
 Travel and shopping: Book early for the Diwali week, and expect crowded trains and markets.
 Banking: Do big transactions before November 6, since closures cluster around November 8 to 15.
 Pensioners: Submit the life certificate early in the month.
 Parents and students: Check your school or college circular, as holidays vary by state and institution.
 Important days in November 2026 International
